summary_en: NIHON KOGYO authorized acquisition of up to 400,000 shares (13.6% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥600 million through market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 from November 2, 2026 through March 31, 2027, to support shareholder returns on the company's 70th anniversary, fund employee stock incentive programs, and secure M&A/alliance transaction consideration.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on Provisions of Article 41 of the Articles of Incorporation pursuant to Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
On October 27, 2026, NIHON KOGYO's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock up to a maximum of 400,000 shares, representing 13.6% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock held as of September 30, 2026 (2,938,389 shares). The maximum acquisition amount is ¥600 million. The company will conduct the acquisition through market purchases, including transactions via ToSTNeT-3, from November 2, 2026 through March 31, 2027.

The company stated three primary reasons for the buyback. First, to enhance shareholder returns on the occasion of the company's 70th anniversary. Second, to support human capital initiatives by implementing and expanding employee stock incentive programs for group employees. Third, to secure shares for use as consideration in M&A transactions and corporate alliances to advance the medium- and long-term business expansion strategy outlined in the group's business plan announced on April 28, 2025.

The company has set target dividend payout ratio of 35% and target total shareholder return ratio of 50%, and views human capital as one of the most important resources in management. The treasury stock acquisition is positioned as part of broader capital allocation reflecting these strategic priorities.
